G3 & $\theta>0$; $\theta=1$ is the logistic law & D, M & \checkmark\,S1 \\
G5 & Without predators, $K$ is locally asymptotically stable iff $r\tau^{x}<\pi/2$; inconclusive at equality & M & \checkmark\,S6 \\

G6 & Gompertz: $r\ln(K/x)\to\infty$ as $x\to0^{+}$; not Lipschitz at 0 but solutions unique; $x=0$ neither reached nor left in finite time unless immigration, constant yield or herd behaviour act at $x=0$ & M & \checkmark\,S7, S7b, S8d, S21 \\
G7 & Strong Allee: $0<A<K$ & M & \checkmark\,S2a, S2c \\

P19 & Holling II (T2.2): a predator with death rate $m$ persists only if $e/h>m$ & M & \checkmark\,S9, S42f \\
